name: having-group-reduction
description: Catch post-aggregation filtering regressions at realistic group shapes

queries.name: large-regions
queries.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY region HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY region

queries.name: popular-categories
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY category

queries.name: active-users
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 50

queries.name: region-revenue-floor
queries.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 10000 ORDER BY region
